Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Ianen Tavek: 34-year-old man, 161 cm (short), exceptional bodybuilder construction with enormous but coherent human muscle mass, skin value band-1-lightest. Face: wide triangular face; small bright eyes and fine straight brows; prominent bridge, compact mouth; no added facial mark. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: violet-plum-pink, short-textured-crop, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: tailored-longcoat, specifically a cloth longcoat with a readable waist, split hem, plain underlayer, and fitted shoes; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette lilac-smoke. Visible personal details: one hand-sized botanical shoulder tattoo; a hand-painted hem mark. Make unusual but bounded color blocking the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: meticulous daily maintenance. Color treatment: lets faded and repaired areas vary the palette. Pose cue: posture is upright but not military, with wrists loose and hands readable. Include a travel tally cord only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.
